text: Scope is locked. Now the first real architecture decision: which services actually build this -- and it's a serverless AWS pipeline, not a bigger spreadsheet.
Each service gets exactly one job: Kinesis receives the stream, Lambda writes it to the raw lake untouched, and Glue catalogs and curates it into a clean, de-duplicated dataset.
Redshift's gold schema is the only layer either Caldera team ever queries directly -- daily installation performance, and monthly billing.

Five thousand installations reporting every few minutes is over a million events a day. A monthly spreadsheet export is exactly what caused Harlan Voss's error -- scaling it wouldn't fix that, it would just delay the next one.
Next: the first lesson where the AWS console actually opens, standing up the real pipeline.
